added.title: Amped Up
added.info: Ensure your audio devices are ready for use. A fully charged set of earphones allows you to enjoy music, podcasts, or audiobooks without interruption.

added.title: Proof Positive
added.instruction: Write unit tests for a feature.
added.info: Strengthen your code quality by creating tests. This ensures your features work as expected and minimizes bugs. A critical part of any coding project.

added.title: Second Opinion
added.info: Improve your work and the work of others through constructive peer review. Offer and receive feedback for mutual growth and collaborative success.

added.title: Sped Up
added.info: Improve application performance by optimizing database queries. This ensures quicker data retrieval, improving the overall user experience and system efficiency.

added.title: Nailed It
added.info: Maintain your personal grooming by filing your nails. This keeps them neat, healthy, and reduces the risk of snagging or breaking.

added.title: Lather Up
added.info: Replenish your hygiene essentials by purchasing a bar of soap. Having soap available ensures you can maintain good personal hygiene habits.

added.title: Final Answer
added.info: Complete your assigned schoolwork and studies, reinforcing concepts and increasing your understanding, while also adhering to deadlines and managing your time.

added.title: Noteworthy
added.info: Review your lecture notes to reinforce learning. Organizing and summarizing key points will help with retention and understanding for exams.
Express happiness or positivity by smiling. This can have a mood-boosting effect for yourself and others around you, promoting well-being.

added.title: Punctuation Mark
added.instruction: Snap your fingers after each sentence.
added.info: Add a playful twist to your speech by snapping your fingers after each sentence. It's a fun way to bring awareness to your speech patterns.

added.title: Exit Strategy
added.info: Test your puzzle-solving skills and enjoy a thrilling experience with friends by participating in an escape room challenge.

added.title: Step by Step
added.info: Learn new dance moves while getting a workout. A dance class helps improve coordination, flexibility, and is a great creative outlet.

added.title: Pointe of Grace
added.info: Explore the grace and discipline of ballet through its basic movements and techniques. It is an art form that requires dedication and precision.

added.title: Old Ties
added.info: Reconnect with an ex-partner, whether to check in or to clear the air and gain closure for the sake of the past. Approach with respect and clear intent.

added.title: Mic Drop
added.info: Share your expertise or personal thoughts by creating a podcast episode. It is a creative project to voice out ideas and connect with listeners.

added.title: Polly's Parlor
added.info: Welcome a pet parrot into your life and enjoy a unique animal companion that is not only beautiful, but also able to mimic human speech.

added.title: Loop de Loop
added.info: Explore 3D modelling by creating a virtual donut in Blender. This will enable you to learn a new digital art skill and produce visual design.

added.title: Fourscore
added.info: Go on a search for a rare 4-leaved clover and appreciate the beautiful details of nature. It may bring luck to you and your day.

added.title: Flipside
added.info: Challenge your body and mind by attempting a backflip. It is a test of agility, strength, and confidence.

added.title: Word for Word
added.info: Engage with religious texts by memorizing a bible verse. It provides an opportunity to reflect on faith and religious principles.

added.title: Beneath It All
added.instruction: Buy a new set of underwear.
added.info: Freshen up your wardrobe with a new set of underwear. This ensures you have clean and comfortable essentials for everyday wear.

added.title: Change of Heart
added.info: Express empathy and kindness by giving alms to someone in need. This small act of charity can make a difference to someone's day.

added.title: Significance
added.instruction: Learn the basics of sign language.
added.info: Enhance your communication skills by learning basic sign language. This is a way to connect with the deaf community and appreciate visual communication.

added.title: Hues Clues
added.instruction: Learn how to solve a Rubik's cube.
added.info: Challenge your problem-solving and cognitive skills by learning to solve the Rubik's Cube. It takes practice, patience and logic to get it perfect.

added.title: Art of the Fold
added.info: Improve your home organization and maintain your belongings by neatly folding your clothes. This saves space and reduces clutter.

added.title: Teeth Vs. Air
added.info: Have fun and improve your speech by memorizing a challenging tongue twister. It provides for a funny way to practice enunciation and articulation.

added.title: Somebody's Calling
added.info: Personalize your phone with a ringtone that matches your style or mood. It makes your phone uniquely yours and can lift your spirits.

added.title: Briefly, a Dragon
added.instruction: Find a cloud that looks like an animal.
added.info: Engage with nature and express imagination by spotting an animal shape in the clouds. It's a fun way to appreciate nature's abstract art.

added.title: Bitter Beats
added.instruction: Listen to a music genre you hate.
added.info: Challenge your musical comfort zone by listening to a genre you dislike. It's an opportunity to broaden your understanding of music, potentially find hidden gems, or at least gain a new appreciation for your preferred styles. You might be surprised what you find in the unknown.

added.title: Folded Breeze
added.info: Engage in a simple craft and create a paper fan. This activity can provide a moment of creativity, plus the finished product can provide a gentle breeze on a warm day. It's a classic art form that can be both beautiful and functional.
